title: EnhancedParticles
description: This project adds a simple keybind to toggle particles on and off instantly. Configure the bind in Minecraft Controls and switch particles anytime while playing.
body:
# EnhancedParticles

A simple client-side mod to toggle all particles on and off.

## Features
- Toggle particles with the **P key**
- Keybind changeable in Controls
- Works on any server
- Hotbar feedback on toggle

## Compatibility
- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+
- Fabric API required
